description: Change of use from a mixed-use industrial warehouse (Use Class B8), to an event and live music venue (Sui Generis) [Retrospective]
decision_conditions: <p>Maximum visitor attendance at the Site must not exceed 4,000 persons at any one time. The above limitation does not apply to site staff and vendors.</p><p><br></p>
<p>The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.</p><p><br></p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p> Block Plan – drawing no.SIT101 – dated 18/06/25</p><p> Existing Layout Plan – drawing no.SIT103 – dated 21/10/25</p><p> Pre-Existing Layout Plan – drawing no.SIT103.1 – dated 21/10/25</p><p> Statement of Community Involvement – n.d.</p><p> Site Waste Management Plan – n.d.</p><p> Delivery and Service Plan – n.d.</p><p> Dispersal Management Plan - dated 16/06/2025 V1.1</p><p> Acoustic Report - dated 08/10/2024</p><p> Flood Risk Assessment – ref: 95985-Woodswhur-RiverRd - dated August 2025</p><p> Fire Statement - dated 22/12/25</p><p> Energy Statement including ventilation statement - ref: QTE023010</p><p> - dated 27/01/2026</p><p> Lighting Assessment – ref: 30316-LIGH-0401 – dated Jan 26</p><p> Streetview Images (first image dated March 2022)</p><p> Concept and Design Details of the interior of the building (WIP DECK – dated Summer 2025)</p><p> Travel Management Plan - dated 20/03/2026</p><p>version to be sent shortly)</p><p> Venue Management Plan - dated 31/07/2026</p><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p><p><br></p>

<p>Planning permission is granted for a period of 5 years from the date of this planning permission. The use hereby permitted shall be discontinued on or before the expiry of the relevant five-year period.</p><p><br></p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall be operated in accordance with the Transport Management Plan, prepared by EP Team and dated 20th March 2026 as approved by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p>a) Within three months of the date of this permission, a Travel Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall follow the Transport for London Travel Plan Guidance and shall include detail of a scheme of monitoring with the LPA’s Travel Plan Coordinator.</p><p>b) Within one year of the date of this permission, an updated Travel Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This shall detail the measures implemented, the effectiveness of those measures, and any further actions required to improve sustainable travel outcomes. Specifically, it should include details of any patterns, trends, or issues identified in relation to the operation of the development, including but not limited to vehicle movements, parking demand, taxi pick-up and drop-off activity, pedestrian movements, and any highway safety concerns or complaints arising from the use. The updated Travel Plan shall include measures to improve the effectiveness of the previous Travel Plan approved under part a) of this condition, with input from the LPA’s Travel Plan Coordinator.</p><p><br></p>

<p>The installation of 6no. Sheffield stands shall be completed within 3 months from that date of this planning permission. The cycle parking shall thereafter be maintained for the lifetime of the development.</p><p><br></p>

<p>Within 3 months of grant of this planning permission, an Event Management Plan to mi􀆟gate the</p><p>occurrence of noise disturbance to neighbouring proper􀆟es shall be submitted to the Local Planning</p><p>Authority (LPA) for its approval in writing.</p><p>The Event Management Plan shall include as a minimum the following details:</p><p> Hours of Use</p><p> Noise Management</p><p> Capacity Limit</p><p> Admission policies and anti-social behaviour procedures</p><p> Staff training</p><p> Stewarding</p><p> Risk Assessment</p><p> Extensive CCTV at the premises</p><p> Barriers</p><p> Fire safety</p><p> Smoking area management</p><p> Emergency Planning and Evacuation Plans</p><p> First Aid</p><p> Audience Profiles</p><p> Temporary Structures</p><p> Litter Disposal</p><p> Public Excretion (such as through the provision of portable toilets on the way to the site)</p><p> Communication Protocols</p><p> Scheme of engagement with nearby residents prior to large events</p><p> Onsite contact number should any nuisances and disturbances need to be reported at the time of events</p><p> Traffic and Transport Planning including taxi or private hire vehicle pick-up and drop-off management</p><p> Delivery and servicing arrangements</p><p> Details of the arrangements for the orderly arrival and departure of attendees, including traffic and pedestrian management measures, stewarding provision at key locations, and other procedures to ensure the safe and efficient movement of people before, during, and after the event.</p><p>Thereafter, the development shall be operated in accordance with the approved EMP.</p>

<p>Within 3 months of grant of this planning permission, a scheme of Acoustic Protection prepared by a suitably qualified noise consultant shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority (LPA) for approval in writing.</p><p>As a minimum the scheme shall provide the level of protection detailed in the Report on Music Noise Survey at Riverside Venue River Road Barking by Shaun Murke Acoustic Consultants which was submitted in support of the application. The scheme shall detail both structural acoustic treatments to the buildings and proposed noise reduction measures.</p><p>Full details of all calculations and modelling used to inform the scheme shall be provided within the report.</p><p>Any works which form part of the scheme shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained as approved.</p>

<p>Within 3 months of grant of this planning permission, a noise management plan to mitigate the occurrence of noise disturbance, at the nearest noise sensitive premises shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority (LPA) for approval in writing. The Plan shall be prepared by a suitably qualified noise consultant.</p><p>The Noise Management Plan shall include as a minimum the following details:</p><p>i. The location of the premises and a description of the activities that will be undertaken at the premises</p><p>ii. The location of the nearest noise sensitive premises</p><p>iii. Operating hours</p><p>iv. Control measures to minimise and manage noise from the premises</p><p>v. Complaint response procedure</p><p>vi. A monitoring plan</p><p><br></p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall achieve security standards (based on Secured by Design principles) to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and the Metropolitan Police, details of which shall be provided to the Local Planning Authority for its written approval within three months of the date of this planning permission. All security measures applied to the approved development shall be permanently retained thereafter.</p><p><br></p>
borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
